Jimmy Darmody's mother is played by Gretchen Mol, who at the time of filming was 38. Jimmy Darmody's girlfriend/common law wife is played by Aleksa Palladino, who at the time of filming was 30. It's plausible that she could be robbing the cradle.

But Jimmy Darmody is played by Mitchell Pitt. He was 29 at the time of filming, less than ten years younger than the woman playing the part of his mother.
